criteria.description: One flexible top media region, one cover image, one bottom band, one h1, one description, and exactly two CTA destinations exist with no excluded parts
Mobile stacks heading then description/actions; desktop uses two top-aligned columns
Section fills the viewport, top media consumes remaining height, image covers it, and the page does not overflow
Both CTA anchors resolve and remain usable with JavaScript disabled
Semantic order, visible focus, 44px targets, reduced motion, themes, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Uses documented layouts/tokens with no framework, placeholder URL, primitive palette, or hardcoded color leakage
Codex reviewed fresh desktop, seam, mobile, dark, reduced-motion, and JS-disabled captures
